cohort: Pregnant women admitted to Arash Hospital in Tehran, Iran, from 1 March to 1 September 2020
finding: While there was no significant association between COVID-19 infection and most pregnancy and neonatal outcomes, the need for ICU care was significantly higher in pregnant women with COVID-19 compared to those without.
mod_finding: COVID-19 infection was significantly associated with an increased risk of Caesarean section.
